customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile (content hash or seed uuid); one profile per member subscriber, employer group or dental/vision practice

customer_type.meaning: kind of party the profile belongs to: an individual subscriber, an employer that sponsors a group contract, or a dental/vision practice in the provider network

name.meaning: legal name of the subscriber, employer or practice exactly as on file

account_number.meaning: the number the caller reads off their own documents: the member ID printed on the ID card (individuals), the group number (employers) or the Cascade provider number (practices)

date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the individual subscriber; empty for employer and practice profiles

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the SSN (individuals) or of the federal tax identification number (employers and practices)

postal_code.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address on file

state_code.meaning: state of residence (individuals) or situs state (employers, practices); determines the filed rate area and the state schedule used

profile_opened_date.meaning: date this profile was first opened with Cascade Mutual

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record; one record per customer, upserted on each attempt

customer_id.meaning: customer whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether verification has passed on this contact; never goes back from true to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the transfer-to-representative record

reason.meaning: why the contact was transferred; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

dental_plan_id.meaning: primary id of one person's dental PPO enrollment (one record per enrolled person: the subscriber and each enrolled dependent)

customer_id.meaning: subscriber who owns the enrollment (foreign key -> customers); dependents' enrollments carry the subscriber's id

billing_account_id.meaning: premium billing account that funds this enrollment (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

group_contract_id.meaning: employer group contract the enrollment is offered under (foreign key -> group_contracts); empty for individual-market enrollments

variant_name.meaning: dental PPO plan held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (basis in products/dental.yaml lifecycle)

market_segment.meaning: market the enrollment was sold in: direct individual, individual through the state health insurance exchange (stand-alone dental plan), or employer group

coverage_tier.meaning: coverage tier the subscriber elected; every enrollment of the same subscriber and plan carries the same tier

enrollee_name.meaning: full name of the person covered by this enrollment

enrollee_date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the covered person; basis for every age limit

enrollee_relationship.meaning: relationship of the covered person to the subscriber

enrollment_type.meaning: how the enrollment entered: an individual-market application, a group open enrollment, a group new-hire election, a special enrollment after a qualifying event, or a late entrant outside those windows

application_date.meaning: date the signed application or group election was received

coverage_effective_date.meaning: first day of coverage under the current continuous enrollment; waiting periods count from this date

tier_change_effective_date.meaning: date the most recent plan upgrade or downgrade took effect; empty if the plan has never changed

prior_variant_name.meaning: plan held immediately before the most recent plan change; none if the plan has never changed

prior_coverage_months.meaning: months of continuous prior dental coverage documented at enrollment (certificate of creditable coverage); 0 when none was documented

prior_coverage_end_date.meaning: last day of the documented prior dental coverage; empty when none was documented

benefit_period_start_mmdd.meaning: month and day the benefit period resets (01-01 for individual-market enrollments; the group's plan-year anniversary for group enrollments)

termination_date.meaning: last day of coverage; empty while the enrollment is applied or active

termination_reason.meaning: why coverage ended or was cancelled; not_terminated while applied or active

cob_order.meaning: whether this plan pays first or second when the person also has other dental coverage; none when no other coverage is on file

other_carrier_name.meaning: name of the other dental carrier on file for coordination of benefits; empty when none

dental_claim_line_id.meaning: primary id of one adjudicated (or pended/reprocessed) service line of a dental claim

dental_plan_id.meaning: enrollment the line was adjudicated under (foreign key -> dental_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/dental.yaml

claim_number.meaning: claim number printed on the Explanation of Benefits, e.g. D26-0418-55021; one claim can carry several lines

line_number.meaning: position of the service line within the claim

provider_agreement_id.meaning: participation agreement of the treating practice (foreign key -> provider_agreements); empty when the practice holds no Cascade agreement

network_status.meaning: network the line was adjudicated under, fixed by the treating practice's agreement status on the procedure start date

cdt_code.format: D followed by 4 digits (ADA CDT code)

procedure_category.meaning: Cascade benefit category the CDT code maps to; drives service class, frequency and age limits

service_class.meaning: service class the procedure category falls in under the enrollment's plan on the date of service

tooth_or_area.format: tooth number 1-32, primary tooth letter A-T, quadrant UR/UL/LR/LL, or FM for full mouth

date_of_service.meaning: completion date of the procedure (seat/insert date for crowns, bridges and dentures; obturation date for root canals); coverage must be in force on this date

procedure_start_date.meaning: date a multi-visit procedure was started (preparation or access date); equals date_of_service for single-visit procedures

extraction_date.meaning: for a bridge, denture or implant line, the extraction date reported for the tooth being replaced; empty for other lines

adjudicated_date.meaning: date the line was decided and the Explanation of Benefits issued; the adverse-determination notice date for appeal timing

benefit_year.format: YYYY (calendar year in which the benefit period containing date_of_service began)
benefit_year.meaning: benefit period the line counts toward

submitted_amount.meaning: fee the practice billed for the line

allowed_amount.meaning: maximum allowed for the billed procedure under the applicable fee schedule or UCR basis

alternate_allowed_amount.meaning: allowance of the alternate (least costly professionally adequate) procedure when an alternate benefit applies, e.g. the amalgam allowance for a posterior composite; equals allowed_amount when no alternate benefit applies

deductible_applied.meaning: portion of the allowed amount applied to the deductible on this line

coinsurance_pct.meaning: plan coinsurance percentage applied to the line

cob_other_paid.meaning: amount the other (primary) carrier paid for the line when this plan is secondary; 0.00 otherwise

plan_paid.meaning: amount Cascade paid on the line; 0.00 for denied and pended lines

member_responsibility.meaning: amount the patient owes for the line (for in-network lines never more than allowed minus plan payment)

remark_code.meaning: Explanation of Benefits remark code explaining the line outcome

original_claim_line_id.meaning: for a reprocessed line, the line being replaced (foreign key -> dental_claim_lines); for a line released from a premium-grace pend, the pended line; empty otherwise

dental_appeal_id.meaning: appeal whose decision caused this reprocessing (foreign key -> dental_appeals); empty otherwise

dental_estimate_id.meaning: pre-treatment estimate the service was performed under (foreign key -> dental_pretreatment_estimates); empty when none

dental_accum_posting_id.meaning: primary id of one accumulator posting

dental_plan_id.meaning: enrollment whose accumulator moves (foreign key -> dental_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/dental.yaml

dental_claim_line_id.meaning: claim line that caused the posting (foreign key -> dental_claim_lines); empty for a year-end rollover credit

benefit_year.meaning: benefit period the posting counts toward (for a rollover credit, the benefit period that earned it)

amount.meaning: size of the movement; the direction is given by event_type (postings and credits add, reversals and draws subtract)

dental_estimate_id.meaning: primary id of one pre-treatment estimate line (or of its voiding)

dental_plan_id.meaning: enrollment the estimate was issued under (foreign key -> dental_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/dental.yaml

estimate_number.meaning: estimate reference printed on the pre-treatment estimate, e.g. PTE-26-30418

provider_agreement_id.meaning: participation agreement of the practice that requested the estimate (foreign key -> provider_agreements); empty for a non-participating practice

network_status.meaning: network the estimate was computed under

cdt_code.format: D followed by 4 digits (ADA CDT code)

procedure_category.meaning: Cascade benefit category of the proposed procedure

tooth_or_area.format: tooth number 1-32, primary tooth letter A-T, quadrant UR/UL/LR/LL, or FM
tooth_or_area.meaning: tooth or area of the proposed procedure

received_date.meaning: date the estimate request was received

issued_date.meaning: date the estimate (or the void) was issued

valid_through.meaning: last date of service the estimate applies to; empty on a void row

estimated_allowed.meaning: allowance the estimate was computed on (after any alternate benefit)

estimated_plan_payment.meaning: plan payment estimated as of the issue date

estimated_member_cost.meaning: patient cost estimated as of the issue date

estimate_remark.meaning: outcome remark printed on the estimate or the reason for voiding it

original_estimate_id.meaning: on a void row, the estimate being voided (foreign key -> dental_pretreatment_estimates); empty on an issued row

dental_appeal_id.meaning: primary id of one appeal filing or appeal decision

dental_plan_id.meaning: enrollment the appealed determination was made under (foreign key -> dental_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/dental.yaml

dental_claim_line_id.meaning: claim line whose denial or reduction is appealed (foreign key -> dental_claim_lines); empty for an appeal of an estimate

dental_estimate_id.meaning: pre-treatment estimate whose adverse outcome is appealed (foreign key -> dental_pretreatment_estimates); empty for a claim appeal

appeal_type.meaning: post_service for a claim already adjudicated, pre_service for an adverse pre-treatment estimate

decision_due_date.meaning: date by which the appeal must be decided

decided_date.meaning: date of the decision; empty on a filing row

outcome.meaning: appeal result; pending on a filing row

original_appeal_id.meaning: on a decision row, the filing decided; on a second-level filing, the first-level decision being appealed; empty otherwise (foreign key -> dental_appeals)

dental_request_id.meaning: primary id of one member coverage-change request

customer_id.meaning: subscriber who made the request (foreign key -> customers)

dental_plan_id.meaning: enrollment the request concerns (foreign key -> dental_plans)

requested_variant_name.meaning: target plan for a tier_change request; none for other request types

requested_effective_date.meaning: date the change takes effect, as determined under the coverage-change rules

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

ortho_rider_id.meaning: primary id of one person's orthodontic benefit rider

customer_id.meaning: subscriber who owns the rider (foreign key -> customers)

dental_plan_id.meaning: dental PPO enrollment of the same person the rider is attached to (foreign key -> dental_plans)

billing_account_id.meaning: billing account that funds the rider premium (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

variant_name.meaning: orthodontic rider held, written as the official full rider name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the rider (basis in products/ortho.yaml lifecycle)

enrollee_name.meaning: full name of the person the rider covers (same person as the attached dental enrollment)

enrollee_date_of_birth.meaning: date of birth of the covered person; basis for the orthodontic age limit

application_date.meaning: date the rider application or election was received

rider_effective_date.meaning: first day of rider coverage; the orthodontic waiting period counts from this date

prior_ortho_coverage_months.meaning: months of continuous prior orthodontic coverage documented at enrollment; 0 when none

termination_date.meaning: last day of rider coverage; empty while applied or active

termination_reason.meaning: why the rider ended or was cancelled; not_terminated while applied or active

lifetime_benefit_paid.meaning: orthodontic benefit paid under this rider to date; always equal to the rider's initial and installment payments minus reversals

ortho_case_event_id.meaning: primary id of one orthodontic case event (establishment, transfer or closure)

ortho_rider_id.meaning: rider the case is paid under (foreign key -> ortho_riders)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/ortho.yaml

case_number.meaning: orthodontic case number printed on the case approval letter, e.g. OC-26-11873; stays the same across a transfer

provider_agreement_id.meaning: participation agreement of the treating orthodontic practice after this event (foreign key -> provider_agreements); empty for a non-participating practice

network_status.meaning: network status of the treating practice on the event date

case_origin.meaning: new_start when appliances were placed while the rider was in force; takeover when treatment began under another carrier or before the rider

appliance_type.meaning: type of orthodontic treatment: comprehensive fixed braces, comprehensive clear aligners, or limited/interceptive (phase I) treatment

banding_date.meaning: date the appliances were first placed (first aligner delivery for clear aligners); for a takeover, the original placement date

treatment_months.meaning: total planned months of active treatment from banding_date, per the orthodontist's treatment plan

months_remaining.meaning: planned months of active treatment remaining at the event date (equal to treatment_months on a new_start establishment)

total_case_fee.meaning: orthodontist's total fee for the treatment plan including retention

allowed_case_fee.meaning: case fee recognised by Cascade: the contracted fee for a participating practice, the out-of-network allowance otherwise

event_date.meaning: date the case event was recorded

closure_reason.meaning: why the case closed; not_closed on establishment and transfer rows

original_case_event_id.meaning: on a transfer or closure row, the establishment row of the case (foreign key -> ortho_cases); empty on an establishment row

ortho_payment_id.meaning: primary id of one orthodontic benefit payment or reversal

ortho_rider_id.meaning: rider the payment is made under (foreign key -> ortho_riders)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/ortho.yaml

ortho_case_event_id.meaning: establishment row of the case the payment belongs to (foreign key -> ortho_cases)

installment_number.format: integer; 0 for the initial payment, 1 upward for installments
installment_number.meaning: position of the payment in the case payment schedule

service_period.format: YYYY-MM (first month of the period the payment covers)
service_period.meaning: month (monthly schedule) or first month of the quarter (quarterly schedule) the payment covers; for the initial payment, the banding month

payee.meaning: who receives the payment: the treating practice under assignment of benefits, or the member

provider_agreement_id.meaning: participation agreement of the practice paid (foreign key -> provider_agreements); empty when the member is paid

amount.meaning: payment size; direction given by event_type (payments add to lifetime benefit paid, reversals subtract)

payment_date.meaning: date the payment or reversal was issued

original_ortho_payment_id.meaning: on a reversal, the payment reversed (foreign key -> ortho_payments); empty otherwise

ortho_request_id.meaning: primary id of one rider change request

customer_id.meaning: subscriber who made the request (foreign key -> customers)

ortho_rider_id.meaning: rider the request concerns (foreign key -> ortho_riders)

requested_effective_date.meaning: date the change takes effect under the rider change rules

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

vision_plan_id.meaning: primary id of one person's vision plan enrollment (one record per enrolled person)

customer_id.meaning: subscriber who owns the enrollment (foreign key -> customers)

billing_account_id.meaning: billing account that funds the premium (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

group_contract_id.meaning: employer group contract the enrollment is offered under (foreign key -> group_contracts); empty for individual enrollments

variant_name.meaning: vision plan held, written as the official full plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the enrollment (basis in products/vision.yaml lifecycle)

market_segment.meaning: market the enrollment was sold in

coverage_tier.meaning: coverage tier the subscriber elected; the same on every enrollment of the subscriber's plan

enrollee_name.meaning: full name of the covered person

enrollee_date_of_birth.meaning: covered person's date of birth; basis for child benefits and the dependent age limit

enrollee_relationship.meaning: relationship of the covered person to the subscriber

application_date.meaning: date the application or group election was received

coverage_effective_date.meaning: first day of coverage under the current continuous enrollment

benefit_period_start_mmdd.meaning: month and day the benefit period resets (01-01 individual; the group's plan-year anniversary for group)

tier_change_effective_date.meaning: date the most recent plan change took effect; empty if never changed

termination_date.meaning: last day of coverage; empty while applied or active

termination_reason.meaning: why coverage ended or was cancelled; not_terminated while applied or active

vision_claim_id.meaning: primary id of one vision claim service (exam, lenses, frame or contact lenses) or its reversal

vision_plan_id.meaning: enrollment the service was adjudicated under (foreign key -> vision_plans)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/vision.yaml

claim_number.meaning: claim number on the vision Explanation of Benefits, e.g. V26-0722-30418

provider_agreement_id.meaning: participation agreement of the eye-care provider (foreign key -> provider_agreements); empty for a non-participating provider

network_channel.meaning: network channel of the provider on the date of service: a participating independent practice, a participating retail-chain location, or out of network

date_of_service.meaning: date of the exam, or the date eyewear or contact lenses were ordered

exam_type.meaning: kind of exam service; not_applicable for materials

lens_type.meaning: spectacle lens type; not_applicable for exams, frames and contact lenses

lens_options.format: comma-separated list from: polycarbonate, scratch_coating, uv_coating, anti_reflective_standard, anti_reflective_premium, photochromic, tint; empty when none
lens_options.meaning: lens options ordered with spectacle lenses

contact_lens_reason.meaning: whether contact lenses were elective or medically necessary under the plan criteria; not_applicable for other services

retail_charge.meaning: provider's retail price for the service

allowance_applied.meaning: plan allowance applied (frame or contact-lens allowance); 0.00 where no allowance applies

copay_applied.meaning: copays charged to the member on this service (exam, materials, lens type and lens option copays)

overage_discount_applied.meaning: discount taken off the amount above the allowance at a participating private practice

plan_paid.meaning: amount Cascade paid for the service (to the provider in network, to the member out of network)

member_paid.meaning: amount the member pays for the service

original_vision_claim_id.meaning: on a reversal, the service reversed (foreign key -> vision_claims); empty otherwise

vision_request_id.meaning: primary id of one vision coverage-change request

customer_id.meaning: subscriber who made the request (foreign key -> customers)

vision_plan_id.meaning: enrollment the request concerns (foreign key -> vision_plans)

requested_variant_name.meaning: target plan for a tier_change request; none otherwise

requested_effective_date.meaning: date the change takes effect under the coverage-change rules

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

billing_account_id.meaning: primary id of one premium billing account

customer_id.meaning: party billed: the individual subscriber, or the employer for a group account (foreign key -> customers)

group_contract_id.meaning: group contract billed by this account (foreign key -> group_contracts); empty for individual accounts

variant_name.meaning: billing arrangement held, written as its official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the account (basis in products/billing.yaml lifecycle)

closed_date.meaning: date the account was closed; empty while open

payment_method.meaning: how the account normally pays: automatic bank draft, card, check, or employer remittance for group accounts

aptc_monthly_amount.meaning: advance premium tax credit the exchange pays toward the monthly premium on an exchange account; 0.00 when none

paid_through_date.meaning: last day of the latest coverage month fully paid; empty before the binder is paid

grace_period_start_date.meaning: first day of the first unpaid coverage month when the account entered its current grace period; empty when not in grace

balance_due.format: USD, 2 decimal places; negative = credit balance

billing_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one billing ledger entry

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/billing.yaml

coverage_month.meaning: first coverage month the entry applies to (an invoice for several months starts here)

months_covered.meaning: number of consecutive coverage months the entry covers, starting at coverage_month

product_line.meaning: product the entry relates to; combined for invoices, payments and fees covering the whole account

amount.meaning: size of the entry; direction given by event_type (invoices, returned payments, fees and refunds raise the balance; payments and credits lower it)

payment_method.meaning: how a payment or refund moved; not_applicable for invoices, fees and credits

payment_purpose.meaning: what a payment was taken for; not_applicable for other entries

payment_reference.meaning: check number, bank trace number or card confirmation of a payment, return or refund; empty for other entries

credit_reason.meaning: reason for a premium credit or a refund; not_applicable for other entries

original_billing_txn_id.meaning: for a returned payment, the payment returned; for a returned-payment fee, the return; for a refund, the credit refunded (foreign key -> billing_transactions); empty otherwise

billing_account_id.meaning: account the request concerns (foreign key -> billing_accounts)

requested_payment_method.meaning: new payment method for a payment_method_change; none otherwise

requested_effective_date.meaning: date the change takes effect under the billing rules

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

employer_contribution_pct.meaning: share of employee-only premium the employer pays

dental_variant_offered.meaning: dental PPO plan the group offers; none when not offered

vision_variant_offered.meaning: vision plan the group offers; none when not offered

dental_rate_member_only.meaning: contracted monthly dental rate for member_only for the current rate period

dental_rate_member_spouse.meaning: contracted monthly dental rate for member_spouse

dental_rate_member_children.meaning: contracted monthly dental rate for member_children

dental_rate_family.meaning: contracted monthly dental rate for family

vision_rate_member_only.meaning: contracted monthly vision rate for member_only; member_spouse and member_children rates are this rate times the charter ratios

vision_rate_family.meaning: contracted monthly vision rate for family

eligible_employees.meaning: employees eligible for coverage on the latest census

new_hire_waiting_days.meaning: employer's eligibility waiting period for new hires; coverage starts the first of the month after it is completed

renewal_date.meaning: next plan-year anniversary on which rates and plans renew

rate_guarantee_end_date.meaning: last day of the current rate guarantee

termination_date.meaning: last day of the contract; empty while applied or active

termination_reason.meaning: why the contract ended or was cancelled; not_terminated while applied or active

group_eligibility_event_id.meaning: primary id of one group eligibility event (member add, member termination, COBRA election or census report)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/group.yaml

employee_name.meaning: employee (subscriber) the event concerns; empty on a census report

employee_date_of_birth.meaning: employee's date of birth; empty on a census report

entry_reason.meaning: reason for the add, termination or election

coverage_tier.meaning: coverage tier added or ended; not_applicable on a census report

qualifying_event_date.meaning: date of the event giving rise to the change (hire date, qualifying life event, last day of employment); empty on a census report

event_effective_date.meaning: date coverage starts or ends because of the event

reported_date.meaning: date the employer reported the event to Cascade

enrolled_employees.meaning: on a census report, employees enrolled in the dental plan

eligible_employees_reported.meaning: on a census report, eligible employees

original_eligibility_event_id.meaning: for a COBRA election, the member termination it continues (foreign key -> group_eligibility_events); empty otherwise

savings_membership_id.meaning: primary id of one dental and vision savings membership (a discount plan, not insurance)

values: Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Individual
Cascade Smile & Sight Savings Plus Household
variant_name.meaning: savings membership held, written as its official full name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (basis in products/savings.yaml lifecycle)

billing_frequency.meaning: how the membership fee is charged

household_members.meaning: persons covered by the membership including the primary member

enrollment_date.meaning: date the membership was purchased; the money-back period counts from it

activation_date.meaning: first day discounts may be used

renewal_date.meaning: next date the membership fee renews

cancellation_date.meaning: last day of the membership after cancellation or expiry; empty while pending or active

fee_balance.meaning: membership fees owed; always equal to fees billed and refunds minus fees paid and credits

savings_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one membership fee entry or recorded discounted visit

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from products/savings.yaml

fee_component.meaning: fee an entry relates to; not_applicable for visits

fee_period_start.meaning: first day of the membership period a fee entry covers; empty for visits

amount.meaning: size of a fee entry (direction given by event_type); for a visit, the savings amount (usual fee minus discounted fee)

txn_date.meaning: date of the entry or the visit date

payment_reference.meaning: card confirmation or refund trace number; empty otherwise

credit_reason.meaning: reason for a fee credit or refund; not_applicable otherwise

original_savings_txn_id.meaning: for a credit, the fee credited; for a refund, the credit refunded (foreign key -> savings_transactions); empty otherwise

provider_agreement_id.meaning: savings-network agreement of the practice for a visit (foreign key -> provider_agreements); empty otherwise

service_category.meaning: discount category of a visit service; not_applicable for fee entries

usual_fee.meaning: practice's usual fee for the visit service; empty for fee entries

discounted_fee.meaning: fee the member paid under the savings schedule; empty for fee entries
